# Roadmap Phase Template

**Document ID:** TEMPLATE-ROADMAP-ITEM

**Schema version:** 1

**Kind:** roadmap/status

**Lifecycle:** current

**Subject:** template for an accepted outcome and its acceptance criteria

**Surface:** template

**Boundary:** global

**Authority role:** non-normative

**Mutation:** authored

**Indexing:** exclude

Add a phase when its direction/scope is accepted. TODO links to it for
execution; task status and run logs do not belong in this block.

```text
### PXL-ROADMAP-NNN — Outcome title

**Rationale and source:** the problem, why it matters, and the accepted decision
**Outcome:** observable result for the consumer
**Accepted scope:** included responsibilities and explicit exclusions
**Acceptance criteria:** what establishes the outcome, with required evidence layers
**Work:** link to the TODO entry
```

Preserve permanent rules and freezes in their governing section. On closure,
retain this block verbatim with the outcome and evidence disposition; do not
rewrite its original intention to match what happened.
